name: sidecar-pi-lifecycle
//: Present so `node` treats sidecar-lifecycle.js as ESM when the behavioral equivalence test drives it directly. Only sidecar-lifecycle.js is ever installed beside a user's Pi; this file is a build-time detail of the repo and is not part of the asset. Pi itself does not need it: its loader imports a bare .js extension file through jiti, which does not consult a package.json type field.
